title: Add OctoPrint browser integration smoke test
description: Run a temporary OctoPrint instance with the plugin and exercise the real settings page in a headless browser. Verify plugin asset loading, settings viewmodel initialization, absence of browser-console errors, rule add/remove/reorder behavior, and settings save round-trip. Use a virtual printer or other disposable test environment; do not require physical printer hardware.

title: Add explicit run-once rule execution
description: Add an explicit per-rule execution mode for commands that should run once when a rule becomes active instead of repeating on an interval. Requirements: add a clear UI option labeled Run once when activated; preserve interval values when switching modes; execute once on first match; do not rerun on duplicate M117 or PrinterStateChanged events while active; reset when the rule stops matching so it can run again; handle print start/end transitions including cooling; keep interval 0 invalid/disabled; add backend tests for activation, duplicate events, reset/reactivation, and precedence; add frontend tests for execution-mode controls and save serialization; update README.

title: Build automated test coverage
description: Establish reliable automated coverage for the repeating command plugin before implementing additional execution modes. Cover backend behavior, frontend rule UI behavior, and package/plugin loading.

title: Add backend unit tests for rule scheduling
description: Test rule matching, filtered-rule precedence, M117 substring matching, printer-state matching, print lifecycle behavior, invalid intervals, timer transitions, and legacy settings fallback.
close_reason: Added backend unit coverage for rule matching, lifecycle, timers, intervals, and legacy settings

title: Add frontend unit tests for rule editor
description: Test late settings initialization, initial rule creation, add/remove/reorder behavior, six-rule limit, filtering controls, legacy conversion, and save serialization.
close_reason: Expanded frontend viewmodel tests for initialization, legacy conversion, rule editing, limits, ordering, and save serialization

title: Add package and plugin loading tests
description: Verify the OctoPrint entry point, plugin import, settings/template registration, JavaScript asset inclusion, and package metadata/assets in the built wheel.
close_reason: Added package metadata, entry-point, and plugin asset tests; integrated them into run-tests.sh
